faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our services

items.question: What should I prepare for my first consultation?
items.answer: Bring documents related to your matter, such as contracts, decisions, notices from authorities, photos of the site if relevant, and a timeline of events. Our team will also guide you by phone before the consultation.

items.question: How are legal consultation fees calculated?
items.answer: VP Luật offers a free 15-minute initial consultation. Further consultations and legal services are priced flexibly based on the matter, complexity, and time required. We provide transparent quotes before starting work.

items.question: Do you support clients overseas?
items.answer: Yes. We support clients through video calls, email, and international phone calls. Lawyers can meet at our office or another convenient location by request.

items.question: How long does a case usually take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the type and complexity of the matter. Simple cases may take 1-3 months, while complex disputes or M&A matters may take 6-12 months or longer. We provide an estimate after reviewing your documents.

items.question: Do you keep client information confidential?
items.answer: Absolutely. Client information is protected under applicable law and professional ethics. We use it only for the consultation and do not disclose it to third parties without consent.

items.question: How can I pay for legal services?
items.answer: We accept bank transfers, cash at the office, and common electronic payment methods. For larger matters, staged payment plans may be available.

1.question: Can I receive a free consultation?
1.answer: Yes. We offer a completely free 30-minute initial consultation. You can visit our office, call us, or speak with a lawyer by video call.

2.question: How long does an email response take?
2.answer: We reply to emails within 30 minutes during working hours and within 4 hours outside working hours. For urgent matters, please call 1900 1234.

3.question: Does VP Luật offer after-hours support?
3.answer: Yes. Hotline 1900 1234 operates 24/7 for urgent matters. Our lawyers are ready to support you whenever you need us.

4.question: Can I visit the office without an appointment?
4.answer: We recommend booking in advance for the best service. However, you may still visit directly and our reception team will help arrange support.
